split.decision: User decision: 15 full-field frames public validation, 60 full-field frames hidden evaluation. Fixed physical sensor network drawn once with official random strategy, seed 42. Only its 64 pixel observations are public in real-season adaptation; simulation full fields remain public. Frame membership and opaque IDs generated privately. Original sparse temporal adaptation window unchanged. Each scoring unit comprises three independent fits, with three outer BENCH_SEED replicates to measure variability.
